note: Kalba i Dibba Al Hisn (wschodnie wybrzeże Szardży) – uzupełnienie jak Khor Fakkan, na prośbę właściciela 25.11.2026. Godziny otwarcia centrów EPAA w źródłach się różnią – nie wpisane.

places.name: Khor Kalba Mangrove Centre
places.description: Visitor centre in the Al Qurm protected area, among the oldest mangroves in Arabia. Boardwalks and exhibits on the mangrove's crabs, turtles and birds, including the rare collared kingfisher.
places.price_text: About AED 15 for adults; children under 12 free

places.name: Al Hefaiyah Mountain Conservation Centre
places.description: Wildlife centre at the foot of the Hajar Mountains with around 30 native mountain and desert species, among them Arabian leopards, tahrs, wolves, caracals and gazelles, in indoor and outdoor enclosures.
places.price_text: AED 25 for adults; children under 12 free

places.name: Kalba Bird of Prey Centre
places.description: Falcons, eagles, owls and vultures in walk-in aviaries, plus a free-flight demonstration of about an hour in an outdoor arena. Al Ghail Fort stands inside the grounds. Tickets at the gate.

places.name: Kalba Corniche
places.description: Seafront promenade with gardens, play areas and space for picnics, a favourite evening walk in Kalba.

places.name: Al Hefaiyah Lake
places.description: Lake at the edge of the mountains near Kalba, with pedal boats, kayaks, a walking path and picnic spots.

places.name: Kalba Hanging Gardens
places.description: Terraced gardens on a mountainside above Kalba with viewpoints over the town and the coast.

places.name: Bait Sheikh Saeed Bin Hamad Al Qasimi
places.description: Restored early-20th-century residence of a former ruler of Kalba, now a small museum of local history and traditional architecture.

places.name: Khor Kalba Fort
places.description: Historic coastal fort of Khor Kalba, part of Sharjah's east-coast forts added to UNESCO's tentative World Heritage list.

places.name: Dibba Al Hisn Fort
places.description: Restored fort on 17th-century foundations that gave the town its name, with a watchtower looking over Dibba Bay. Part of the UNESCO tentative-list coastal forts.

places.name: Dibba Al Hisn Beach
places.description: Quiet white-sand beach and beach park next to the corniche, with clear water for swimming and snorkelling and views of the Musandam mountains.

events.title: Eid Al Etihad Celebrations in Dibba Al Hisn
events.description: Sharjah's Eid Al Etihad programme reaches Dibba Al Hisn with two days of celebrations at the town's flagpole site.
